input_policy: Use the exact frozen all_110 inputs and question after the V4.1 one-time run has completed.
decision_policy: Use deterministic/v2-interval-policy-v1 so the comparison introduces no external decision-model credential or stochastic decision policy.

non_comparable_metrics.fine_site_macro_f1: V2 exposes only inside_gauge/outside_gauge and cannot distinguish outside_gauge_non_root from grip_root.

regression_rule.direction: V4.1 minus V2 must be at least -0.03 for each supported numeric key metric.

special_case_rule.direction: V4.1 must be exact on the identical special-case subset and may not have fewer correct cases than V2.
